active_corner_reduction.definitions: Let A be the average of the +h and -h low-variance corner densities, B the corresponding high-variance average, and p_rho=rho*A+(1-rho)*B. Let C_L=E_q[A/p_rho], C_H=E_q[B/p_rho], D(rho)=C_L-C_H.
active_corner_reduction.strict_monotonicity: D'(rho)=-E_q[(A-B)^2/p_rho^2] < 0 unless A=B q-almost surely, so the active-pair root is unique.
active_corner_reduction.four_corner_consequence: At D(rho)=0 the identity forces C_L=C_H=1. Because q and p_rho are even in the block mean, the +h and -h directional expectations within each variance pair are equal. Therefore a certified root bracket collapsed to a point/root condition automatically establishes all four active-corner equalities; four separate directed integrations are not an independent proof obligation.
